_README: Canonical VG3 cid3 parameters for the restart. Grouped by grounding. See ../PARAMETER_AUDIT.md for the full classification of each value.
_reversals: exc_rev glutamate=0. inh_rev=-60 (Friedrichsen chloride reversal; canonical). -45 (pure shunting) is the explored alternative â€” see audit.
_synaptic_weights: exc_weight in uS per synapse (from Kim conductance fit). inh effective weight = inh_weight * inh_scale. on_scale_exc multiplies ON-BC weights to offset the 30-ON-vs-75-OFF count asymmetry (WORKAROUND - see audit).
_kinetics: Sustained graded-release model (single event, long tau). Friedrichsen used fast 1/1 and 1/3 ms. inh decay 300ms is slow for GABA-A - see audit.
_stimulus: Gaussian-blurred spot; sigma = bipolar RF size.
_surround_hill_STALE: Phenomenological Hill surround functions fit to Kim 1F under the OLD fast taus + combined-BC stimulus. Quantitatively stale - refit before quantitative use.
_fitted_exc_on: ON EPSC two-Hill fit (2_fit_on_epscs); on_scale fixed.
_fitted_inh: Inhibition fit (3_fit_inhibition); A_off=1, A_on<1; inh_weight_fitted is the effective per-synapse weight.
